people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Hebrews

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the offspring of Abraham? So am I.
